title: Migration runner mode: atBoot on long-lived Node, ciStep on Workers-adjacent or container-scheduled targets; elicited
context: A long-lived Node process can run migrations at boot before opening the first request; a Workers-adjacent or serverless target cannot because the boot happens per invocation and does not amortise the migration cost. A container platform running warm instances behaves like long-lived Node but a fresh-per-request container behaves like Workers.
decision: The migration runner mode is elicited: atBoot (the facade invokes the runner on process start before opening the first query) or ciStep (the CI pipeline invokes the runner as a deploy step before promoting the artefact). Default atBoot for long-lived Node targets; default ciStep for Workers-adjacent, request-scoped container, or Hyperdrive-fronted (round-6) targets. The applying project answers the elicit at apply time; the sidecar records the answer.
consequences: Long-lived Node targets get zero-config migrations that run before the first request; the operator sees the migrationsApplied event in the process log and knows the schema advanced. Workers-adjacent targets get a CI-step that runs against the deploy target's own connection before the artefact promotes; the operator sees the runner's stdout in the CI log. A project moving from long-lived Node to Workers-adjacent updates the elicit and re-applies; no code moves. Standards trace clause: generic enterprise practice.

alternativesConsidered.name: Always atBoot
alternativesConsidered.summary: Ship atBoot as the only mode; the operator schedules a boot on the CI runner for ciStep-like behaviour.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: A Workers-adjacent deploy has no long-lived boot event to hang the runner on; the operator would have to build a boot shim just to run migrations, which is the ciStep in disguise. Eliciting the mode is cheaper.

alternativesConsidered.name: Always ciStep
alternativesConsidered.summary: Ship ciStep as the only mode; a long-lived Node process reads schema_version at boot and refuses to open if it is behind.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: Local development on long-lived Node loses zero-config migrations; every developer has to invoke the CI step by hand. atBoot as the default for long-lived Node keeps the developer flow ergonomic.
